h1: Dornbracht bathroom installation in Stoke Poges

hero.intro: Stoke Poges' larger properties often run to more than one bathroom needing attention at once — the space here, much of it set well back from the road on sizeable gardens, regularly stretches to a second en-suite off a principal bedroom as well as the main family bathroom. Specifying Dornbracht across more than one of those rooms means the same finish discipline has to hold on every fit, not just one: it's a German brassware house built around sculptural handle and spout design, in finishes that are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere, and a scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum tap or a rough-in set a few millimetres out is far more visible — and costlier to correct — than the same mistake on a mainstream brand. We fit Dornbracht fit-only across Stoke Poges, room by room, to that standard.

sections.heading: What Dornbracht brings to a Stoke Poges bathroom
sections.body: Stoke Poges' larger executive-style builds and period detached homes, many close to Stoke Park, tend to support bathroom schemes with the scale for a design-led brassware choice. Dornbracht's sculptural handle and spout design — across taps, mixers and shower valves — suits that kind of specification: it's brassware chosen to be a feature in its own right, not just a fitting that happens to supply water. Across more than one bathroom in the same property, that consistency of finish matters as much as the individual fit.

sections.heading: Fitting the same standard across every room
sections.body: When a Stoke Poges specification puts Dornbracht brassware in a principal en-suite and a family bathroom in the same project, we treat each room to the same fitting discipline: rough-in dimensions confirmed against the manufacturer's spec before any wall closes up, and the finished brassware protected from the other trades still working elsewhere in the house. A scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish is no less visible in a second en-suite than in the main bathroom, so we don't let the sequencing slip on the room that gets fitted last. In practice that means fitting the rooms in a deliberate order rather than whichever is most convenient on the day — closing up and protecting a finished principal en-suite before the family bathroom's first fix generates the dust and splash a later Dornbracht fit would otherwise be exposed to.

sections.heading: How Stoke Poges' larger plots change the layout
sections.body: The scale common around Stoke Poges — large plots, properties set back from the road, and room enough for a second en-suite off a principal bedroom — generally gives more flexibility to reposition a waste run, widen a doorway for level access, or add a bathroom where one didn't exist before, than a smaller property allows. That extra flexibility is useful for planning a Dornbracht layout, but the finish and rough-in precision the brand demands stays exactly the same regardless of how much room there is to work with.

sections.heading: Fit-only, Dornbracht included
sections.body: We work fit-only across Stoke Poges: you source your Dornbracht brassware, and we handle strip-out, first fix, plumbing, tiling coordination and snagging, from £3,500, across one bathroom or several in the same project. A £125 survey comes first, confirming the exact products specified in each room before anything is ordered. With 30 years' experience, that multi-room consistency is something we plan for rather than leave to chance.

faqs.q: Can you fit Dornbracht across more than one bathroom in the same project?
faqs.a: Yes — it's common in Stoke Poges' larger properties, where a principal en-suite and a family bathroom are often fitted in the same programme. We apply the same rough-in and finish-protection discipline to each room.

faqs.q: Does fitting Dornbracht in a second en-suite cost less than the main bathroom?
faqs.a: Not because the brand is more forgiving — a scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish is just as visible in a second en-suite. Pricing depends on the scope of each room, from £3,500.

faqs.q: Do Stoke Poges' larger plots make Dornbracht installation more flexible?
faqs.a: They help with layout — relocating a waste run or adding a second en-suite is usually more straightforward on a larger plot — but the finish and rough-in precision Dornbracht needs doesn't change with the size of the room.

faqs.q: What if a Dornbracht tap or valve develops a fault after installation?
faqs.a: We offer repairs from £200, with a £500 minimum emergency call-out fee. We don't offer standalone regrouting as a repair service.
